title: Courses Corpus Changelog
description: Per-file edit history for markdown courses and lectures in the corpus (src/course/app/courses/**/*.md). Agents append one entry per touched course entry or lecture per change set.
$comment: Entry objects in changelog.json must keep their object key order identical to this schema's property order.

file_path.description: Corpus-relative path of the changed markdown course entry or lecture.

kind.description: Optional change kind; commit-type words (feat, fix, docs, ...) suggested.

commit.description: Full sha of the commit that introduced the change; filled post-commit by bin/link_changelog_commits.py.

before.description: Full sha of the parent commit — the 'state before'. Omitted when the course entry or lecture did not exist there. The 'state after' is the introducing commit itself.
